Started!');r.onVisibilityChange=function(){};r.onBlur=function(){};window.addEventListener('blur',e=>e.stopImmediatePropagation(),true);document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',e=>e.stopImmediatePropagation(),true);if(!window._origRAF){window._origRAF=window.requestAnimationFrame.bind(window);window.requestAnimationFrame=function(cb){if(document.hidden&&window.dinoBotRunning){window._bgCb=cb;return l(){if(!window.dinoBotRunning)return;if(r.crashed){s(32,'keydown');setTimeout(()=>s(32,'keyup'),100);requestAnimationFrame(l);return;}if(r.currentSpeed<TARGET_SPEED){r.setSpeed(TARGET_SPEED);}const
